description: Replace the current query-param-based navigation (?view=, ?session=, ?speaker=) with path-based routing using wouter v3. Migration is fully incremental — every commit is deployable, old URLs continue working until explicit removal steps. See craft2026/plan.md for architecture and route map.

description:
Run `npm install wouter` in app/. Verify the build compiles and all 312 unit tests still pass. No application logic changes.

Acceptance: `npm run build` and `npm run test:run` both pass in app/.

description:

Final cleanup after all migration steps are complete.

- Run npm run test:run in app/ — all tests pass

- Remove dead code, unused imports, dead CSS

Nav bar buttons are NOT changed in this step. Both URL forms show the same view.

Acceptance: e2e test from step 2 passes. All existing e2e tests and unit tests still pass.

title: Update nav bar to navigate to new paths (decision point)
description:
Explicit decision: update the nav bar buttons to push new paths instead of old query params.

- Schedule tab → navigate to /
- My Schedule tab → navigate to /myschedule
- Speakers tab → navigate to /speakers
- Settings (⚙) tab → navigate to /settings
- openSession(id) → navigate to /session/:id
- openSpeaker(slug) → navigate to /speaker/:slug

IMPORTANT: Call saveScrollToState() before each navigate() call, exactly as the old hooks did, to preserve scroll restoration behaviour.

The old param-handling code in App.tsx stays in place — bookmarked legacy URLs still work via the coexistence logic added in steps 3-6.

Update e2e tests that click nav buttons to assert on new URL paths.

Acceptance: nav clicks land on new paths, all e2e tests pass.
Commit message: `feat: nav bar navigates to path-based routes`

title: Redirect legacy query params to canonical paths (decision point)
description:
Add redirect logic: when the app boots with an old-style param in the URL, silently replaceState to the canonical path.

Redirect map:
  /?view=myschedule         → /myschedule
  /?view=speakers           → /speakers
  /?view=settings           → /settings
  /?session=616             → /session/616  (preserves other query params like ?day=)
  /?speaker=gergely-orosz   → /speaker/gergely-orosz

This keeps all old bookmarked URLs working permanently, now via a client-side redirect.

Update the existing e2e tests in routes.spec.ts to expect the new path after redirect (add waitForURL or check page.url()).

Acceptance: old ?view= URLs still show the right view, URL bar now shows the canonical path. All tests pass.
Commit message: `feat: redirect legacy query params to canonical paths`
